name: rate-ticker
title: RateTicker
summary: Warp signature. Horizontal marquee of freight lane rates. Pure CSS animation. Edge-fade gradients give it the 'windowed view onto a stream' feel. Three speeds (slow/normal/fast). Mono-numeric prices with up/down arrows. Honors prefers-reduced-motion (track becomes static).
description: Horizontal lane-rate marquee. Warp SIGNATURE — landing-page only.
skillDescription: Use on the landing hero or a marketing surface to surface live freight rates. The animation establishes 'this is a live system' visually. Three speeds for context (hero = slow, in-product = normal). NEVER use in dense operator chrome — it's a marketing voice element.
anatomy: Marquee container (.lumen-ticker-track, duplicated content for seamless loop)
Rate row: from → to · price · trend arrow · separator dot
Edge fade gradients (sunken → transparent, left + right 48px)
never: NEVER use in dense operator chrome (it's a marketing voice element).
NEVER allow rates count to drop below 5 (marquee becomes obviously short).
NEVER animate faster than 40s — too anxious.
a11yRules: aria-label='Live freight rates' on the root.
Trend arrows are aria-hidden — the up/down meaning is in the price comparison.
do: Use slow speed for hero context.
